subject.title: Show DeepSeek Platform usage with cost summary

question: Should enabling any DeepSeek Cost summary display mode be accepted as consent to query the selected Chrome Platform session, replacing the separate credits-and-extras opt-in?
rationale: This is a user-facing privacy and provider-session policy change, not a mechanical correction: both choices are implementable but establish different persistent-preference semantics for existing users.

options.title: Keep explicit session consent
options.body: Retain the credits-and-extras gate for the Chrome-derived Platform usage probe while allowing Cost summary only to control presentation.

options.title: Approve unified Cost summary consent
options.body: Treat Cost summary as the sole consent control, but document the browser-session probe in the setting and verify upgrade and opt-out behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit session consent
recommendation.body: Retain the credits-and-extras gate for the Chrome-derived Platform usage probe while allowing Cost summary only to control presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice defines the product and consent contract for existing CodexBar users.
